thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed across prod region us-west-2. Alert: batching scheduler queue depth spike leading to head-of-line blocking. paging sre_oncall (on-call)

sre_oncall: digging in now. thanks bot. anyone seeing customer-facing errors? 

maya_k: Yep seeing RTT spikes and timeouts in the gateway logs around 23:04 UTC. Multiple 504s, some 502s. Latency jumped from ~120ms to 2s+.

alex_r: I'm seeing batcher latency graphs explode, scheduler queue length up ~15x. KV cache prefetch churn high. Could be runaway prefetch/backpressure.

jess_p: Noted elevated error rate on hosted API keys for several customers — a few support tickets incoming. Customer-impact: increased error rates for streaming responses, some retries failing.

incident-bot: Summary snapshot: 5xx rate 18% (baseline 0.5%), gateway 504s spiking, batcher queue depth > 10k for several shards. Auto-escalation to eng_runtime_oncall.

eng_runtime_oncall: joining. First steps: validate whether this is capacity saturation or scheduler loop. Can someone share a sample affected request id?

maya_k: sample request ids: req_7a3f2, req_7a3f7, req_7a4b9. Gateway logs show "upstream timed out" followed by "batcher: queue timeout after 10s".

alex_r: Running quick query on metrics: 
```
# prometheus
sum(rate(batcher_queue_depth[1m])) by (shard)
sum(rate(batcher_processing_latency_seconds_bucket[1m]))
```
Result: spikes concentrated on shard-7 and shard-9, queue depth per-shard ~3700 and 4100.

eng_runtime_oncall: looks like localized shard overload + KV prefetch causing head-of-line. Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route new requests away from shard-7/9 (reroute to spare capacity), 2) reduce batching window to shorten tail latency, 3) enable aggressive eviction of KV prefetch for affected shards, 4) open canary fallback to smaller model variant for affected customers.

sre_oncall: executing routing change now. Command: 
```
# reroute traffic away from shard-7/9
rbctl route update --pool inference-us-west-2 --exclude-shards 7,9 --reason "incident 3098765432: shard overload"
```

sre_oncall: applied. Watching ingress.

maya_k: saw immediate drop in new queue enqueues to those shards. However backlog still high; head-of-line continues to produce timeouts for in-flight batches.

jess_p: notified top 5 affected customers via status page partial outage note. PM @pm_luis looped in.

pm_luis: thanks — please include ETA for recovery and whether we need to offer credits. Keep me posted.

alex_r: reducing batch window threshold to 20ms to force smaller batches: 
```
# update scheduler config
configctl set batch_window_ms --value 20 --target shards 7,9
```

eng_runtime_oncall: also toggling aggressive kv eviction for those shards: 
```
# quick toggle
runtimectl set kv_prefetch_eviction --policy immediate --shards 7,9
```

sre_oncall: both changes applied. Monitoring tail latency and 5xx rate.

(2m later)

maya_k: 5xx rate dropping to 6%. Gateway 504s reduced by ~65%. Throughput slightly down but much healthier latency.

eng_runtime_oncall: good. Now draining backlog: manual eviction + prioritized draining of small batches. Command: 
```
batcherctl drain --shards 7,9 --mode priority-small-first --timeout 300
```

alex_r: starting drain. Will keep an eye on head-of-line metrics to ensure we don't preempt healthy requests.

(5m later)

maya_k: drain progressing. queue depth for shard-7 down from 3700 -> 900; shard-9 4100 -> 1200. 5xx ~2.1% now.

jess_p: support update posted. Tickets being triaged — some customers saw transient failures but retries succeed.

eng_runtime_oncall: next steps: 1) keep reroute in place until backlog drained and tail latency stable for 10m; 2) run post-incident root cause: why KV prefetch churned and why scheduler allowed backlog to grow on specific shards; 3) consider automated circuit-breaker to prevent single-shard runaway.

sre_oncall: oncall handing off to eng_runtime_oncall for RCA and long-term fixes. Closing live mitigation. If metrics regress, re-open page.

pm_luis: appreciate the fast mitigation. Please include customer impact summary and timeline in the postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation successful, suppressing alerts for 1h. Please file incident report under incidents/ with tag batcher_kv_prefetch. :white_check_mark:

eng_runtime_oncall: filing an initial follow-up ticket: "RCA: KV prefetch runaway + scheduler batching policy -> shard-specific queue saturation". Assigning to alex_r and maya_k for deep-dive.

maya_k: attaching quick logs for follow-up: 
```
# sample gateway log
2026-03-15T23:04:12Z gateway us-west-2 req=req_7a3f2 upstream_timeout
2026-03-15T23:04:12Z batcher shard=7 batch_size=128 enqueue_time_ms=4500 process_time_ms=11000 kv_prefetch=enabled
```

alex_r: will also check recent deploys/rolling restarts that might have shifted hot keys to shard-7/9. Suspect hotkey redistribution due to placement rebalance around 23:00 UTC.

sre_oncall: thanks team — marking live handoff complete. If anything else pops, ping in this thread. :thumbsup:

jess_p: closing status page incident once 5xx < 0.5% for 30m.

(End of thread)
